name: nomusic-extension
description: nomusic browser extension (loaded unpacked; not bundled). `type: module` lets the content-script ES modules and the node:test unit suite share .js files.

scripts.pack: if grep -q example.com config.js manifest.json; then echo 'ERROR: config.js/manifest.json still reference the placeholder nomusic.example.com — set your real Cloudflare backend host in both before packaging.' >&2; exit 1; fi && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/nomusic-$npm_package_version.zip . -x 'tests/*' 'dist/*' 'package.json' '.gitignore' '*.DS_Store'
